findings.message: This puts a <Script> inside <Head>. The head component only forwards plain markup into the document head, so the script loader never mounts and the loading strategy is dropped: nothing decides when the script runs and nothing tracks whether it already did. Move the <Script> outside of <Head> and let it sit in the page body.
